releases.name: Companion v0.1.9
releases.body: Native companion binary release for oh-my-opencode-slim.

## What's Changed
* perf(task-reply): drop the dead v2 answers arg and its caveat sentence by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1510
* fix(v2): settle revived children after compaction by @guidan-nick in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1512
* fix(foreground-fallback): walk the chain from the head and skip only tried or abandoned providers by @dhaern in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1511
* refactor(prompt): v1 renders the same slim routing lines as v2; table-drive write capability by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1513
* fix(tasks): let managed Build parents recover their own children by @unsnow-iac in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1516
* fix(release): automatically ship native Companion changes and block stale npm releases by @Aveer in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1514
* test(companion): assert COMPANION_MANIFEST.version instead of hardcoded 0.1.4 by @mhenke in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1525
* perf(task-tools): stop rendering the board generation counter to the model by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1519
* feat(terminal-gate): log-only host-outcome corroboration at publication by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1523
* feat(tui): sibling attribution for parallel same-agent sidebar rows by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1522
* fix(permissions): re-append the delegation stance tail to compiled child payloads by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1520
* refactor(prompt): replace blanket prefer-background with a two-channel rule; drop host-duplicated delegation mechanics by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1521
* perf(council): host-side seat assembly — orchestrator passes refs, harness attaches responses by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1517
* fix(v2): arm the background-default flip on registry replay by @InCerryGit in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1533
* fix(multiplexer): send basic auth on v1 pane wiring reads by @mwoodson in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1529
* docs(triage): add maintainer rejected enhancement records to .out-of-scope by @mhenke in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1524
* feat(acp): select inner models per invocation by @zjm54321 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1465
* chore(config): remove legacy compat paths — removed keys are rejected, docs synced by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1518
* feat(wezterm): add WezTerm multiplexer backend by @mwoodson in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1530
* refactor: post-review streamlining sweep (adjudicated) by @Jiajun0413 in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1534
* fix(v2): skip setup cleanly when OH_MY_OPENCODE_SLIM_DISABLE is set by @mhenke in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1543
* fix(marketplace): use boolean schema for acknowledge flag for Gemini compat by @mhenke in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1545
* test(tasks): add regression test for display-named orchestrator (#1531) by @mhenke in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1544
* fix(wezterm): only treat a missing pane as a closed pane by @mwoodson in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1539
* fix(multiplexer): resolve opencode binary for pane view commands by @mhenke in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1550
* Skip v2 setup when plugin is disabled by @caiozizh in https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/pull/1546
* refactor(v2): leave wait_for_user unr
